The repos

Personal project. Research and learning only. Not for production. No warranty.
  • Built on my own time for research and learning. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by my employer, Liquidware or Microsoft.
  • Don't run any of it in production or against tenants that matter. Test in a dedicated lab subscription and tenant first.
  • Provided "as is", without warranty of any kind, under each repo's license. You use it at your own risk and own the Azure charges it incurs.
  • Contributions and forks are welcome and encouraged. See Contribute.

Every repo is public, open source and the source of truth for itself. The list lives in repos.json, which the site and the family check both read.

Repo Role
avd-current-state What is there now
avd-landing-zone How it's built and changed from here
avd-liquidware Optional Liquidware tier
avd-swarm On top: the how of operating
avd-second-brain On top: the why, over the environment's life

These docs are the Markdown in docs/knowledge/; open the folder in Obsidian to browse it as a vault. Each repo is the source of truth for itself.
